name: Orcish Medicine — a spell's "your choice of lifelink or indestructible" is two modes
notes: "Target creature gains your choice of lifelink or indestructible until end of turn." on a spell produced no effect and no way to choose (audit: no-targeted-effect). A spell line with "your choice of A or B" is rewritten into one mode per item (_yourChoiceOfOptions, as a fired ability's options), so the spell's mode pop-up offers them. Here the second mode is picked: the target gains indestructible and not lifelink.
